title: Proactive snapshot eval launcher for model pin events
creator: Ava Thompson
description:
Goal: Launch a lightweight, deterministic 'snapshot eval' whenever a model version is pinned (catalog or tenant pin) that quickly assesses quality drift and surface actionable signals to engineers and product owners. This ticket scopes the PM-led orchestration, sampling policy, and pass/fail thresholds; implementation will coordinate with ENG for runtime hooks and with Console for visibility and alerts.

Problem statement: Model pins and catalog upgrades are high-risk events for customer-facing regressions. Existing evals run ad-hoc and can be slow/costly. We need an automated, low-cost evaluation that: (1) runs immediately on pin/upgrade, (2) targets tenant-relevant inputs, (3) provides a concise pass/fail + top-3 regression examples, and (4) enforces cost caps and tenant prioritization.

Scope and behavior:
- Trigger conditions: catalog version promotion, tenant model pin, and model config changes that affect tokenization/temperature/temperature-schedule or quantization profiles.
- Sampling: deterministic snapshot of up to N=500 historical prompts per catalog model + tenant-prioritized sample (up to 200 examples) for customer-pinned upgrades; fallback to curated anchor set when tenants have low traffic.
- Fidelity tiers: run a quick tier (low-cost, approximate metrics, e.g., BLEU/embedding-similarity on golden labels) and a follow-up tier that runs higher-fidelity checks only if quick tier shows regression.
- Cost control: per-run soft cap of $X (configurable), with global daily budget throttle and backoff to sampling-only summaries when near cap.
- Results: pass/fail flag, delta metrics (baseline vs candidate), top 3 counterexamples with diffs, suggested severity, and automatic alerting into the pin owner Slack channel + create a short incident-style note in Console.

Why this differs from prior work: we call this a 'snapshot eval' (distinct from existing continuous or canary evals) — designed to be deterministic, low-latency, and tenant-aware with explicit cost controls. It should not replace longer-running fidelity runs but act as an immediate gate and early-warning signal.

Acceptance criteria (high level):
1) A snapshot eval is automatically triggered for catalog promotions and tenant pins with a configurable sampling policy.
2) Eval completes within 10 minutes for catalog-level runs and within 5 minutes for tenant-scoped runs under normal load.
3) Outputs include pass/fail, delta metrics, and top-3 counterexamples surfaced in Console and Slack.
4) Cost per snapshot run stays within configured soft cap and global throttle prevents runaway spend.
5) Owners can opt tenants out or raise priority; opt-outs and priorities are respected immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Trigger on catalog promotion, tenant pin, and relevant config diffs
Complete catalog snapshot within 10 minutes and tenant snapshot within 5 minutes under nominal conditions
Produce pass/fail, delta metrics, and top-3 counterexamples in Console and post summary to owner Slack channel
Respect per-run soft cost cap and global daily budget throttle
Honor tenant opt-out and priority overrides
implementation_notes: Hook points: use existing pin-change event stream; ENG to add lightweight eval rider that schedules snapshot jobs with tenant metadata
Sampling design: combine deterministic archived-prefix sampling + recent-traffic-weighted sampling for tenants with sufficient traffic; curated anchor set for cold tenants
Metric selection: prioritise embedding-similarity to golden outputs, hallucination rate heuristics, and a small set of task-specific metrics (QA F1, code-exec pass) where available
Backoff strategy: if global budget near limit, reduce sample sizes and surface confidence intervals instead of full counterexamples
Data privacy: tenant-specific samples use hashed identifiers; results stored in tenant-scoped, access-controlled Console views
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable for internal catalog promotions only + 3 pilot tenants (2 high-risk, 1 low-traffic) to validate sampling and SLAs. Phase 2: open to all catalog promotions and opt-in tenants. Phase 3: default-on for enterprise+dedicated with configurable thresholds. Each phase includes a 2-week observation window and rollback plan to cancel snapshot runs if cost or false-positive rate exceeds thresholds.
monitoring_and_alerting: Send failure / regression signals to #pins-evals Slack channel and create a linked Console alert. Emit metrics: snapshot.duration, snapshot.cost, snapshot.pass_rate, top-regression-count. Add SLO: 95% snapshot completion within target time per phase.
